verses.verse:
यत आरभ्य आरोहस्तस्मिन्नेव समापनम्।
क्रीयतामचरोहोऽपि तेष्वेवाष्टमात्रिकः।९२।
verses.text: Where the ascent begins, there it should end; let the descent too be made on those same [notes], of eight mātrās (beats).

commentary.text: That is, from whatever note the ascent is made, taking it as 'Sa', end the eighth note, after seven notes, on that same hole. And then, descending from that same note, the eighth count will come back to its earlier place. In this way an ascent of eight mātrās (beats) and a descent of eight mātrās, 16 mātrās in all, will take this form: Sa Re Ga Ma Pa Dha Ni Ṡa, Ṡa Ni Dha Pa Ma Ga Re Sa. By chanting this root mantra of 18 mātrās at least 100 times and at most 1000 times every day, siddhis (accomplishments) are attained.
